units.purpose: A controlled identity image used only to maintain one approved character or manifestation across later scenes.
One principal narrative moment designed for placement in a multi-panel page with known reading order and lettering geometry.
not_for: turning every scene into a poster

units.purpose: One uninterrupted composition reserved for a major emotional, divine or climactic moment selected by the locked storyboard.
not_for: dialogue-heavy scenes better served by panels

selection_rule: The locked storyboard selects the unit. A source scene is never promoted to FULL_PAGE_IMMERSIVE merely because a generator prefers a portrait poster.
